newsitem.title: RWANDA: Aid sources cite incursions into Zaire from Rwanda.
newsitem.headline: Aid sources cite incursions into Zaire from Rwanda.

text.p: Aid agency sources said on Monday unidentified fighters had entered Zaire from Rwanda overnight and attacked government army positions close to Rwandan refugee camps in the eastern Zairean town of Goma.

"There was a sizeable military incursion from Rwanda yesterday (Sunday) which included attacks on FAZ (Zairean army) positions," a senior aid official told Reuters. He said a bus and truck were hit during the attacks but gave no further details. Rwandan army officials could not be reached for comment.
